name: Satya Sundar Samanta

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Satya Sundar Samanta writes English poetry shaped by the landscapes and lives along the Odisha–West Bengal border. His collections include Border Poems, The Still Times and The Subarnarekha. In his publisher’s introduction to Border Poems, he describes journeys through coastal and river country, attending to both its natural beauty and the difficulties of the people who live there. He teaches English at Ramnagar College.

The two poems here hold beauty and unease together. “A Village at Nilagiri” moves from autumn fields and returning workers towards the fears that arrive with darkness. In “Game of Sea”, welcoming waves withdraw with precious stones, leaving an exposed shore. Neither landscape remains an untouched idyll.
